panels.rationale: The image shows a newborn presenting with right congenital knee dislocation (CKD) characterized by fixed hyperextension (-90 degrees), as explicitly stated in the caption and in-text mentions. The figure clearly depicts the clinical manifestation.

panels.figure_caption: Right CKD at birth, with hyperextension at –90° CKD: congenital knee dislocation
in_text_mentions: The newborn was delivered vaginally in cephalic presentation. Apgar scores were 9 and 10 at one and five minutes, respectively. Birth weight was between the 50th and 90th percentiles, and length was between the 10th and 50th percentiles. Postnatal examination revealed right CKD, Grade II, with hyperextension at -90°, without vascular compromise (Figure 1).
